To perform keyboard actions: <COMMAND: KEYBOARD_ACTION>holdKey | iterations | keyCombo | text</COMMAND> (Use 'none' for unused parts. ALWAYS use '+' to separate multiple keys, e.g. 'ctrl+c' or 'up+left'. Never use commas. e.g. <COMMAND: KEYBOARD_ACTION>none | 1 | enter | youtube.com</COMMAND>, <COMMAND: KEYBOARD_ACTION>win | 1 | up+left | none</COMMAND>, <COMMAND: KEYBOARD_ACTION>none | 1 | none | hello world</COMMAND>)

To perform mouse actions: <COMMAND: MOUSE_ACTION> action | button | amount | start | end | direction </COMMAND> (Actions: click, hold&release, scroll. Button: left, right, middle, none. Start/End coords e.g. '960,540' or 'null'. Direction for scroll: up, down. e.g. Click: <COMMAND: MOUSE_ACTION> click | left | 1 | 960,540 | null | null </COMMAND> e.g. Drag: <COMMAND: MOUSE_ACTION> hold&release | left | 1 | 100,100 | 200,200 | null </COMMAND> e.g. Scroll: <COMMAND: MOUSE_ACTION> scroll | null | 5 | 960,540 | null | down </COMMAND>)
